title: Penniston touches craft and receives binary code

tellings.quote: he stated that he touched the surface of the craft noting smooth glass-like material and unusual symbols etched on its side that resembled hieroglyphs according to peneston he experienced a profound telepathic download of binary code after touching the craft

plain: In 1980, in Rendlesham Forest in England, a man named Jim Penniston says he touched an unknown craft and found its surface smooth like glass, with strange symbols carved on its side that looked like hieroglyphs. After touching it, he says, a flood of binary code, the ones and zeros that computers use, came into his mind by telepathy. Michels relays Penniston's account in an episode about UFOs and nuclear bases. If true, it would mean the craft passed a message straight into a witness's head.
